evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never framed the call as '10-15 minutes' with 'a quote you can depend on' or asked for confirmation before diving into probing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asked 'Do you have just any top of my concerns or questions' early, but this was a throwaway yes/no check, not a genuine 'what are your biggest concerns' open-ended probe.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer never raised concerns, so N/A by rule.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Customer raised no concerns, so N/A by rule.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep asked about parking access, big items, and storage location, but did not ask about property type beyond 'one bedroom apartment,' did not confirm number of stories, did not ask about walking distance from truck to unit (only after the customer estimated distance), and did not probe for special considerations or additional stops.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep never asked 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?' — only confirmed unprompted that wrapping and disassembly were included.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep asked 'approximately how many boxes so we typically see about 1525 generally what does that look like?' Customer declined with 'I just need the big pieces,' so the question was asked.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gave hourly rate ($202/hr) and time range (3-4 hours) but did not personalize the estimate to the customer's specific move (one-bedroom, storage destination, long walkway at pickup). Partial.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep disclosed no trip fee, no stairwell fees, mentioned 2.5-hour minimum and hourly increments, but did not frame the estimate as 'not a guess' or provide upfront clarity on all typical fees before the customer asked.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or any version thereof.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep mentioned 'on time guarantee' but did not explain the discount terms (starts discounting immediately if late). Partial.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep stated 'No Worries Damage Coverage...does cover up to $2,000 for an account incidentals' and confirmed it 'includes our no worries damage coverage' as part of the rate (no add-on). Framing of no deductible/no fine print was not explicitly stated, but coverage and inclusion were clear. Full.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' and the Two Promises section was never framed as resolving customer concerns.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asked 'do you have any other questions?' twice near the end—the archetypal throwaway that gets an automatic no, not a genuine 'what's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep never asked 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' The customer initiated the booking ('So I'll reserve it then') after rep offered it was free to reserve.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep confirmed date (Thursday October 1st), arrival window (8:00–8:30 am), and sent a confirmation email. Did NOT confirm phone number on file, crew size, or pickup/destination addresses (already on file but not re-confirmed verbally). Partial.

top_strength: Chauntelle gathered detailed logistics information (parking access, big items, storage location, walkway distance) and explained the fee structure and damage coverage clearly, leaving the customer confident there were no hidden surprises.
coaching_note: Lead with the quid pro quo framing ('10-15 minutes, a quote you can depend on, does that sound good?') before any probing, and close the call with an explicit ask ('Would you like our help with your move?') rather than letting the customer initiate the booking.
